user.title: Choose setup type
user.description: Smart Shading controls each cover only when the sun reaches its facade and the selected sun source confirms active sunlight. Choose Easy for a quick setup with tested, safe defaults: select the covers, facade directions and sun source, and Smart Shading handles the technical settings automatically. Choose Advanced for individual control with schedules, temperature-based heat protection, Night positions, glare protection, pauses, safety sensors, protected zones, custom targets and expert execution settings. In both modes, safety functions and manual cover control always take priority over automatic shading.

data_description.setup_type: Easy asks only for the essentials. Advanced adds selectable comfort and protection functions.

data_description.schedule: Prevents unnecessary movements when the room does not need automatic shading. You can choose months, weekdays and a daily time window.
data_description.temperature: Uses the measured room temperature to move between comfort, solar and heat protection. The room therefore reacts to actual heat instead of the sun position alone.
data_description.night: Uses dedicated night targets and hands control back to daytime automation in the morning. An entity or sunset and sunrise can define the night period.
data_description.safety: Gives wind, frost or window signals priority over comfort. When danger is reported, Smart Shading blocks movement or moves to configured safe targets.
data_description.conditions: Adds weather and occupancy signals so comfort movements happen only when conditions fit. Safety and heat-protection rules keep priority.
data_description.glare_protection: Protects a defined area such as a screen, table or seat from direct sun. Smart Shading calculates the required position from the sun, window and protected zone.
data_description.maximum_opening: Keeps selected position-controlled covers below a hard opening limit, including after an external KNX or wall-switch movement. Feedback is checked immediately and every 30 seconds; Safety keeps priority.
data_description.dashboard_badges: Adds guided setup for the small round house and room status badges. Their cover symbol, state marker and color show the current Smart Shading mode without permanent text.
data_description.test_tools: Creates preview and diagnostic tools after saving and reloading. It has no separate setup step, and test runs never move covers.
data_description.expert_execution: Adjusts command spacing, queues and target verification. This helps with slow drives, large groups or unreliable feedback.

schedule_settings.name: Schedule
schedule_settings.description: The general shading schedule enables the thermally driven daytime functions: adaptive shading, Comfort, Solar and starting heat protection. Glare protection is evaluated all year and all day. Night Mode uses its own independent period.

data_description.end_time: Used only for a fixed time window.
data_description.outside_schedule_behavior: Outside the permitted period, covers open or hold unless year-round glare protection, independent Night Mode or a higher-priority safety constraint applies.

temperature_settings.name: Temperatures and heat protection
temperature_settings.description: Temperature-based daytime shading operates only inside the general shading schedule. Horizontal slats use adaptive normal shading and stronger heat protection. Other cover types use their configured Comfort, Solar and Heat positions; the stages available below depend on the room’s cover types. Heat protection starts at most once per calendar day and ends at the earliest evening boundary.

data_description.indoor_temperature: Select the sensor that provides the room temperature. All temperature stages are configured in this same form.

data_description.solar_temperature: Above this temperature, the stronger Solar target applies when the cover profile supports distinct stages.
data_description.heat_temperature: Above this value, heat protection may start once per day while the general shading schedule is active.
data_description.evening_release_time: The daily heat cycle ends no later than this time. An earlier schedule end or sunset release ends it first.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Negative values release before sunset and positive values afterwards. The earliest release always wins.
data_description.reopen_temperature: Applies only to normal temperature-based shading, not heat protection. Below this value the normal shading request ends; while direct sun remains, the current position is held instead of forcing an immediate opening.
